description: 公共施設一覧(西海市の保育園等) [evacuation shelters and public facilities] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 西海市. 公共施設一覧（西海市の保育園等）の位置情報をcsvファイルで提供しています。. Coverage: 西海市. The portal files it under the publisher 西海市. Its tags are 位置情報, 公共施設, 西九州させぼ広域都市圏. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-07-15 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
